title: LearningLoopResult
description: Interactive coaching output contract emitted by lumei-star-learning-loop-coach.

supported_summary.description: Evidence-grounded reflection summary without evaluative ratings.

capability_anchors.description: Up to 3 Lumei Leadership Competency anchors mapped from observable actions.

development_edge.description: Exactly ONE specific, actionable behavioral boundary identified for growth.

work_context.description: Specific upcoming meeting, task, or interaction

boundary_conditions.description: Preconditions under which the test is safe to conduct

stop_conditions.description: Observable signals that prompt immediate termination of the test

reversibility.description: How the action can be undone or adjusted if unintended side-effects emerge

evidence_to_collect.description: Signals to observe (stakeholder reaction, agreement clarity, dissent signal, follow-through)

rehearsal_offered.description: True if development edge involves conversation and user is offered voluntary practice.

artifact_candidates.description: Recommended artifact types (e.g. IDP Development Note, Manager Discussion Note, Experiment Card)

socratic_question.description: EXACTLY ONE Laser Socratic question targeting the coachee's deepest blind spot.
